geometry: A broad slate-violet stone fighting platform has two shallow terraces joined by wide ramps. Exactly two thick brushed-gold grounding rods stand on low isolated plinths behind and in front of the central combat axis. Broad visible metal channels connect both rods to a monumental rear storm spire. Dry insulated stone passages remain clear around each plinth. The tall spire rises behind the arena and never obscures the floor.

signatureFeature.physicalObjects: A rear storm spire connects visibly to two metal grounding rods on stone plinths. Insulated dry passages and an open centre separate the rods.
signatureFeature.activation: An eligible electrical attack enters a rod's declared interception area and travels into the grounded metal. The resident sets the rods before the bout and their configuration stays fixed.
signatureFeature.consequence: A fighter can bait an electrical attack into a rod, then counter while the attacker recovers. The electrical path visibly ends in the grounded circuit; physical hits and water masses interact with the rod as ordinary solid cover.
counterplay: Change angle to avoid the rod's interception area.
Close the distance and force the defender away from its grounding cover.
limits: The feature creates no free electrical attack for either fighter.
The spire never chooses a winner or strikes a passive fighter with a surprise lightning bolt.
Grounding applies only to the disclosed eligible electrical attacks and geometry.
visualEvidence: An electrical attack leaves its legal source.
Its path visibly connects to a rod.
Energy travels down the metal connection into the plinth and dissipates.
A real counterattack lands while the first attacker recovers.

resident.perch: Rear-left verge at the spire's protected base, with a visible gap from the rod connections.

reset: Restore cover, water, feature phase and every displaced object to the same declared starting state before each bout.
